issues.description: Field mismatch for Animal.name: the problem statement UML declares an attribute 'name' of type String (problem_statement.md line 27), but the solution implementation defines the backing field as a StringBuilder (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Animal.java line 4). This structural type difference can confuse students about the expected field type and the required constructor/getter/setter signatures.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the implementation with the UML by changing the Animal.name field to a String: use 'private String name;', update the constructor to accept a String and assign it, and make getName()/setName(String) operate on String. Alternatively, explicitly document in the problem statement that using a StringBuilder is acceptable; however, prefer changing the implementation to String to match the UML and avoid student confusion.
